purpose: Single-vehicle identity, live readings, independently sourced systems, recent activity, configuration, optional Helix paint proposal and per-vehicle settings.
primaryGoal: Understand this vehicle's current condition and charging options, wake it, inspect recent driving/charging and maintain its overrides without losing independent source evidence.

dataSources.name: vehicleQuery
dataSources.behavior: Enabled for positive finite id; initial vehicle loading selects page skeleton.

dataSources.name: stateQuery
dataSources.behavior: Direct StateResponse envelope; state supplies status, readings, software fallback and next-charge SoC. useDataState labels provenance live; server live flag is not consumed.

dataSources.name: securityQuery
dataSources.behavior: Doors/windows use security snapshot; lock/sentry use independent live state.

dataSources.name: tireQuery
dataSources.behavior: Domain renderer classifies Pa, adapts to kPa and shared display preferences.

dataSources.name: drivesQuery
dataSources.behavior: Same returned five-row source supplies table and reverse-ordered trend; not a full-range chart.

dataSources.name: wakeMutation
dataSources.behavior: Pending wake button, success/error toast; state refetch scheduled after five seconds.

dataSources.name: useVehicleSettings/useUpsertVehicleSetting/useResetVehicleSetting
dataSources.behavior: Read cancellation, 30-second staleTime, normalized settings array; mutations invalidate and broadcast settings and vehicle detail; nickname read shared with settings section.

dataSources.name: useVehicleSilence
dataSources.behavior: SilenceBanner absent on missing data or ok; explanation retained for quiet/silent/never.

dataSources.name: useNextChargeDecision
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only with id and finite current SoC; inferred trust; retained data, fatal retry and two empty cases.

dataSources.name: AIVehiclePaintPreview/useAiStream
dataSources.behavior: Feature gate, positive integer input requirement, scopeKey and optional style_hint; propose-only stream never replaces configuration.

components.name: PageLayout/Section
components.contract: Title/subtitle/breadcrumb/metadataActions/contextActions; section IDs and localized titles; preserve full allocated width.

components.name: VehiclePanelGrid/VehiclePanelCell
components.contract: items: id,size,content; label; delegates to CardGrid/useCardPlacement without another successful-data surface.

components.name: OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics/useVehicleDetailSummary
components.contract: Source-specific trust/time/provenance; raw StatMetric inputs and specialist formatters; shared data-display renderer, no new KPI engine.

components.name: VehicleHeader/VehicleConfigSection/QuickLinksSection
components.contract: Identity/back/wake; twelve configuration rows and software fallback; six destination links.

components.name: VehicleBatteryChart/VehicleDriveChart
components.contract: Existing EmbeddedChart/ChartCard, accessible data columns, current shared chart palette; gauge before battery bars; chartKey battery-drive-trend and series visibility.

components.name: DataTable
components.contract: Stable tableId, row identity, compact pagination, mobileColumns; drive sort callback retained.

components.name: VehicleSettingsTab
components.contract: Six supported keys, source pills, controlled drafts, parse/validate/save/reset; existing Input/Select/Button.

components.name: Feedback and motion
components.contract: LiveStaleDataBanner, SectionErrorBoundary, QueryError, StaleRefreshWarning, EmptyState, Skeleton, useToast, FadeIn; no replacement overlay/motion provider.

components.name: AIVehiclePaintPreview
components.contract: vehicleId, optional styleHint, withAiFeature and AIFeatureCard; gated stream start and redacted/propose-only explanation.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Ten direct query declarations and request calls sit in the page despite domain hook ownership. Existing useVehicle also reads this record with cancellation; inspected useVehicles state contracts include observed_at/freshness/verified_fields absent from local StateResponse.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use or extend typed domain hooks only after comparing exact mapping, keys, poll intervals, enabling and raw envelopes; do not silently substitute a different state contract.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: QuickStats battery accent thresholds (>50, >20) differ from gauge helper thresholds (>60, >25); missing readings cyan versus helper grey. These are two active domain policies, not proof one can be deleted.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reconcile meanings under the existing vehicle domain owner; preserve numeric measurements and record intended distinct thresholds if deliberate.

evidence.detail: Shared CardGrid owns half/full placement; minimum-width containment in grid/cells.
Overview stacks then sm:flex-row; gauge and metric body retained.
Two, three then six link columns.
Single-column rows become twelve-column layout at lg; actions remain present.

issues.detail: mobileColumns omits duration; recent charges mobileColumns omits duration and cost. The shared DataTable detail/column-access implementation was not inspected, so complete mobile reachability is unresolved, not proven lost.
issues.fix: Integration-test full row detail/column access at narrow widths; retain every omitted column through existing DataTable mobile presentation without a second table.

issues.detail: VIN text uses truncate; no local full-value affordance supplied. Actual truncation depends on allocated width.
issues.fix: Verify full VIN is reachable on narrow/200%-text layouts; use existing text/detail affordance if clipping occurs.

accessibility.verified: source only; keyboard, focus, screen reader and effective contrast unverified
accessibility.positiveEvidence: Header Back link has localized aria-label and min-h-11/min-w-11; decorative header icons aria-hidden. Quick links use named nav/focus-visible ring. Chart frames receive ariaLabel and dataColumns.

issues.detail: renderInput creates Input/Select without label, id, aria-label or aria-labelledby. Visible key name is a separate Text at line 249. Validation Text at line 262 is not passed as error/described-by to the control. data-testid is not an accessible name.
issues.fix: Supply stable key-derived control IDs and localized label/help/error association through current primitives; retain draft/value/name semantics and six row identities.

states.initialLoading: VehicleDetailPage:165-170 returns dedicated skeleton; source panels independently resolve loading/error/empty/ready after vehicle loading.
states.invalidId: VehicleDetailPage:173-188 localized not-found branch with Back to vehicles action.
states.fatalRecordError: VehicleDetailPage:224-230 record QueryError and retry; independent sections remain mounted.
states.retainedData: VehicleSourcePanel:25-42 keeps available children and refresh warnings. NextChargeDecisionStrip retains data on refresh failure.
states.offlineStale: Global LiveStaleDataBanner, per-query StaleRefreshWarning and silence watchdog present in source; actual behavior not exercised.
states.empty: Domain placeholders and empty chart/table cards remain; AI intentionally feature-gated, not a missing-data replacement.
states.successDisabled: Wake pending; per-setting save/reset pending/disabled/validation; positive integer AI canStart.

issues.detail: Nullable lock/sentry/climate/charging use truthiness to label unknown as Unlocked/Off/Not charging; SecuritySection already distinguishes null from known false.
issues.fix: Retain all five indicators with explicit localized unknown branches and neutral semantic variants for missing booleans.

issues.detail: Missing battery becomes measured zero in gauge/bar data and remaining becomes 100%; raw metric summary remains unknown. Drive trend similarly coerces missing distance/duration to zero at lines 24-25.
issues.fix: Keep gauge/bar/trend sections and all returned data, but distinguish unavailable chart operands from zero using existing chart states; do not fabricate measurements.

issues.detail: isError branch replaces settings rows even if query retains data on a refresh error, hiding editable values and source pills.
issues.fix: Use existing data trust contract: only fatal error without usable data replaces rows; refresh warning keeps retained rows and drafts.

issues.detail: Only data is destructured; failed watchdog read silently looks like no banner. Missing evidence cannot establish telemetry freshness.
issues.fix: Distinguish failed/unavailable watchdog evidence with existing source feedback while preserving deliberate absence for an actual ok result.

visualIssues.detail: Six navigation tiles explicitly request glow="cyan"; decorative repeated glow is a source-level noise risk. Actual emitted glow/intensity not visually measured.
visualIssues.fix: Remove decorative glow request; preserve hover, focus, icons, label and all six links with existing neutral surface tokens.

visualIssues.detail: Gauge helper uses fixed grey/emerald/amber/red hex strings independently of current theme semantic tokens. Brightness/contrast is unmeasured; semantic battery warning meaning must remain.
visualIssues.fix: Map existing threshold semantics to canonical palette rather than adding local colors or resetting saved chart/theme preferences.

visualIssues.detail: divide-white/5 is fixed-white separator styling. No pure-white text, neon class or glow found in the page itself; this dependency does retain white-based decoration.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral border token; preserve all rows and separators across light/dark/forced-color themes.

architectureIssues.detail: All ten inline read queryFns ignore TanStack Query signal. Nearby useVehicleSettings and inspected useVehicles reads forward it.
architectureIssues.fix: Forward signal through existing typed domain hooks without changing query keys, intervals, raw payload or enablement.

architectureIssues.detail: Finite positive fractional IDs satisfy hasValidId and trigger reads/wake, while AI preview explicitly requires integer ID. Backend rejection behavior was not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Align page identity validation with positive safe integer route IDs; preserve existing localized invalid-id return and disabled requests.

architectureIssues.detail: Direct StateResponse read marks provenance live unconditionally, ignores stateData.live and uses a local envelope lacking the domain hook's observed_at/freshness/verified_fields contract. Network success alone cannot prove freshness of vehicle readings.
architectureIssues.fix: Reconcile with typed state hook owner and expose server evidence in the current trust pipeline, preserving actual raw readings and unknown fields; do not invent backend freshness.

architectureIssues.detail: Missing record and state falls back to offline; independent record failure is not proof of vehicle offline.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep visible identity/header and state derivation for known state; represent unavailable status without asserting offline when evidence is absent.

priority.rationale: Operational trust and settings accessibility take precedence over decorative cleanup. Page already composes reviewed shared layout and independent boundaries; no page replacement is needed.

dependsOn: exact raw API state contract reconciliation
requiredSharedChanges.scope: Report only; other domain hook extensions need exclusive owner assignment.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Per-vehicle settings accessible retained rows
dependsOn: existing Input/Select label and description APIs

requiredSharedChanges.name: Chart missing-measurement semantics
dependsOn: existing EmbeddedChart/ChartCard empty and data-table contracts

requiredSharedChanges.name: Vehicle detail visual restraint
propsVariantsStates: theme-aware battery severity and row borders

competingImplementations.detail: Local record/state request pipeline coexists with domain hook contracts. Exact state equivalence is unresolved; do not swap by name only.
competingImplementations.fix: Consolidate through current domain owner after source-contract comparison.

competingImplementations.detail: Two active battery accent classifiers differ, while all metrics now use the existing OperationalBrief pipeline. No need for a new stats library.
competingImplementations.fix: Resolve documented domain threshold meanings, not a new component or color engine.

sections.name: Identity/header actions and provenance
sections.content: Effective nickname/title, model+trim subtitle, breadcrumb, status, VIN, back and wake, source badge.

sections.name: Telemetry silence and next-charge decision
sections.content: Watchdog explanation; charge verdict/reason, SoC target/energy-needed, home-now/wait/Supercharger costs, start time/site, smart-charge action.

sections.name: Live overview
sections.content: Battery gauge, rated/ideal range, charging state, range-added/hour and time-to-full; five live state badges.

sections.name: Quick stats
sections.content: Eight metrics: battery, range, odometer, speed/motion context, cabin/outside temperature, power and status.

sections.name: Vehicle systems
sections.content: Powertrain eight readings and specialist V/A/Nm/RPM formats; climate eight readings/fallbacks; charging telemetry eight readings, timestamp/source/session and range-rate explanation; security four states and mixed-source evidence; four tire pressures and directional threshold statuses.

sections.name: Battery & range charts
sections.content: Gauge/readouts before current/remaining battery bars; recent five-drive distance/duration trend, axes, legend visibility, accessible data columns.

sections.name: Recent activity
sections.content: Drive date/distance/duration/battery; charge date/energy/duration/cost/battery; table sorting/pagination/IDs and View all.

sections.name: Vehicle configuration plus gated Helix proposal
sections.content: Twelve KV rows: car type, trim, exterior/wheel/roof color/type, charge port, RHD, Europe, offroad lightbar, rear seat heaters, sunroof, software fallback. Preserve separate feature gate, propose-only redaction explanation and scope-key stream.

sections.name: Quick links
sections.content: Drives, Charging, Battery, Climate, Efficiency, Settings destinations.

sections.name: Per-vehicle settings
sections.content: nickname, mute_until, charge_cost_tariff_id, units_distance, units_temperature, units_energy; source pills, local drafts, validation, Save/Reset and RFC3339 conversion.

preservation.countDefinition: Eight loaded semantic content sections = overview, stats, systems, charts, history, configuration, quick links, settings; header and advisory banners inventoried additionally, not counted as content sections. AI is an optional configuration sibling, not a mandatory empty tile.
actions: Back to /vehicles from header and invalid-id branch
Wake POST with pending/toasts and delayed live-state refetch
Record and individual-source retries, settings retry
Open /smart-charge from decision body or empty decision action
Drive distance sort and existing DataTable pagination/column/mobile/detail capabilities
Chart/table inspection and existing ChartCard legend/frame capabilities; preserve any shared export/fullscreen behavior without claiming it was exercised
Six settings Save and Reset actions, validation and source pills
Optional Helix paint draft start/stream and current stream stop/retry capabilities delegated to AIFeatureCard; never auto-apply paint
dataBehavior: Preserve all independent sources, current query keys, positive-ID gates, polling intervals, source order, five-row recent scope and nickname fallback.
Preserve usable retained payload and independent neighbors on source failures, localized placeholders and retry actions.
Keep SI wire/cache/source operands and existing display-only useUnits/useOperationalMetrics/specialist formatters; no backend unit conclusions from examples.
Retain rear/front pack voltage fallback, known-temperature peak, climate fallback order, security split-source attribution and tire pressure threshold meaning.
Retain returned ordering before user drive sort and reversed order for chart; saved table IDs vehicles:detail-recent-drives and vehicles:detail-recent-charges; chartKey battery-drive-trend.
Settings draft edits/dirty/pending/reset behavior, unit preferences and business mute date must survive; do not add a duplicate workspace picker.
Do not preserve fabricated zero/false semantics as trusted measurements when resolving the explicitly reported trust defects; preserve sections and actual source data.

evidenceLimits.mode: Atomic Phase0 source audit only; no source edits, Git, runtime/browser, project TypeScript, tests, lint or build.
evidenceLimits.routeEvidence: Assigned route /vehicles/:id and local breadcrumb string inspected; router reachability/mount not exercised.
evidenceLimits.endpointEvidence: Request paths and methods are source-confirmed in bounded dependencies, not backend router/handler validation. Backend availability, shape, freshness, authorization and unit behavior remain unverified.
evidenceLimits.visual: No screenshots, mounted rendering, theme, forced-color, effective contrast, keyboard, focus, screen-reader, reduced-motion or viewport acceptance claimed.
evidenceLimits.scope: Shared foundations not audited globally. Existing layout/chart/DataTable/AI infrastructure referenced via actual consumer props; implementations outside page-specific trace not recursively inspected.
